title: Password Reset
text: To reset your PulseFlow password, click Forgot Password on the login screen and enter your registered account email. I will immediately send a secure password reset link to your inbox. Please check your spam folder if the link does not appear within two minutes.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
text: To enable two-factor authentication for your PulseFlow account, navigate to Account Settings and select Security. Scan the displayed QR code using your preferred authenticator app like Google Authenticator or 1Password. Enter the six-digit verification code generated by your app to complete the setup.

title: Locked Account Recovery
text: If your PulseFlow account is locked after multiple invalid login attempts, wait 15 minutes for security cooling. Alternatively, click Unlock Account on the login screen to send a verification code to your email. You can also contact support@pulseflow.io for manual identity verification.

title: Updating Account Email
text: To change your primary email address in PulseFlow, go to Account Settings and click Edit next to Profile Information. Type your new email address, enter your current password to confirm authorization, and click Save. I will send a confirmation link to your new address that you must click to finalize the update.

title: Account Deletion
text: To permanently delete your PulseFlow account, visit Workspace Settings and select Delete Account at the bottom of the page. Please note that deleting your account permanently removes all connected workflows, dashboards, and team project history. Ensure you cancel active paid plans prior to requesting permanent deletion.

title: Updating Payment Method
text: To update your credit card or payment details, go to Workspace Settings and select Billing Overview. Click Update Payment Details, enter your new credit card information or PayPal credentials, and save. Your future recurring charges for PulseFlow will automatically bill to this new payment method.

title: Downloading Invoices
text: To view and download past receipts or tax invoices, navigate to Workspace Settings and click Billing Overview. Scroll down to the Payment History section where you can download PDF copies of all previous charges. You can also add your official company name and VAT number to appear on future invoices.

title: Failed Payment Retry Policy
text: If your monthly PulseFlow payment fails, I will send an automated billing alert to your admin email address. Our system will automatically retry charging your primary payment card three times over the next seven days. Please update your billing details promptly at pulseflow.io to prevent service interruptions.

title: Refund Policy
text: To request a refund for PulseFlow charges, submit a ticket to support@pulseflow.io within 14 days of your invoice date. We issue full refunds for accidental duplicate charges or annual plan cancellations requested within the initial 14-day window. Approved refunds are credited back to your original payment method in 5 to 10 business days.

title: Tax and VAT Information
text: To add your company tax identification or VAT number, navigate to Workspace Settings and select Billing Overview. Enter your registered tax numbers in the Tax Details section before starting your subscription. Applicable local sales tax or VAT is automatically calculated and itemized on your monthly invoice.

title: Free Plan Overview
text: Our Free plan is designed for individuals and small teams getting started with PulseFlow. It includes 1 workspace, support for up to 3 team members, 5 active workflows, standard integrations, and access to community support. You can upgrade to a paid tier at any time directly from your workspace dashboard.

title: Pro Plan Features and Pricing
text: The Pro plan costs $29 per month and is built for growing teams needing expanded workflow automation. It includes unlimited team members, 50 active workflows, real-time analytics dashboards, 10GB of storage, and up to 1,000 API calls per minute. You also receive priority email support from our customer care team.

title: Business Plan Features and Pricing
text: The Business plan costs $79 per month and delivers advanced operations controls for scaling companies. It includes unlimited workflows, advanced automated triggers, custom webhooks, 100GB of storage, and 5,000 API calls per minute. Business subscribers also unlock SAML SSO authentication and 24/7 dedicated chat support.

title: Enterprise Plan Custom Options
text: Our Enterprise plan offers tailored solutions for large organizations with custom security and scale requirements. It includes custom SLAs, a dedicated account manager, full audit logs, unlimited storage, custom API rate limits, and self-hosted deployment options. Contact sales@pulseflow.io for custom contract pricing and trial setup.

title: Upgrading or Downgrading Plans
text: To change your subscription tier, go to Workspace Settings and select Plans and Pricing. Select Upgrade or Downgrade next to your desired plan, such as Pro at $29 per month or Business at $79 per month. Plan upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing, while downgrades take effect at the end of your billing cycle.

title: Dashboard Loading Errors
text: If your PulseFlow dashboard fails to load or shows a blank screen, refresh your browser or try opening the page in an incognito window. Clear your browser cache and disable third-party ad blockers or privacy extensions that might block WebSocket traffic. If the issue persists, check our system status page.

title: Workflow Trigger Failures
text: If an automated workflow fails to trigger, navigate to Workflows and click Execution Logs to review the exact error code. Verify that connected third-party app tokens have not expired and that input data matches required schema fields. You can re-run failed workflow executions manually from the log view.

title: Browser Compatibility
text: PulseFlow is fully optimized for the current and previous major versions of Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, and Microsoft Edge. For optimal performance and security, ensure your web browser is updated to the latest build. Using legacy or unsupported browsers may result in visual or functional errors.

title: Mobile App Synchronization
text: To sync your mobile device with your PulseFlow workspace, download our official mobile app for iOS or Android. Ensure your mobile operating system is updated to iOS 15 or Android 10 or higher. Active notifications and task updates will sync instantly across your mobile app and desktop session.

title: Real-Time System Status
text: To check real-time system health or monitor scheduled maintenance, visit status.pulseflow.io to view live operational metrics for our API endpoints, dashboard interfaces, and webhook dispatch servers. You can also subscribe to email or SMS alerts on that status page to receive instant notifications during unexpected service disruptions.

title: Workspace Data Export
text: To export your workspace project data, navigate to Workspace Settings and click Data Management. Select your preferred format, such as CSV or JSON, and click Generate Full Export. I will compile your workspace files and send a secure download link to your admin email address.

title: GDPR and Privacy Rights
text: PulseFlow complies fully with GDPR, CCPA, and global data privacy standards. You maintain full ownership rights to inspect, modify, export, or restrict processing of your personal data at any time. Submit formal data subject requests directly to privacy@pulseflow.io.

title: Data Security and Encryption
text: Your data in PulseFlow is protected using TLS 1.3 encryption in transit and AES-256 encryption at rest. We host infrastructure in SOC 2 Type II certified data centers with continuous monitoring and automated daily backups. We never sell or monetize customer data.

title: Permanent Data Erasure
text: To request complete erasure of your organization data from active servers and backup logs, send a request to privacy@pulseflow.io. We process compliant data deletion requests within 30 days. You will receive an official certificate of data destruction once the process is complete.

title: Audit Log Access
text: To view security event logs on Business and Enterprise plans, go to Workspace Settings and select Security Audit Logs. You can inspect user login timestamps, IP addresses, workflow modifications, and permission changes. Export filtered audit logs to CSV for compliance reporting.

title: Connecting Slack and GitHub
text: To connect third-party tools like Slack or GitHub, navigate to Workspace Settings and click Integrations. Select the app you want to connect and follow the authorization prompts to grant workspace permissions. Once connected, you can trigger automated PulseFlow actions directly from Slack channels or GitHub repository events.

title: Managing API Keys
text: To generate or revoke developer API keys, go to Workspace Settings and select Developer API. Click Create API Key, name your key, and copy the generated secret token immediately. Remember to store your secret key securely, as it will not be displayed again after creation.

title: Webhook Setup and Triggers
text: To create a webhook endpoint, go to Workspace Settings, select Developer API, and click Add Webhook. Enter your target payload URL and select the event triggers you want to listen for, such as task completion or workflow errors. You can send test payloads directly from the dashboard to verify connection status.

title: API Rate Limits
text: API request limits depend on your active plan tier to ensure optimal performance for all users. Pro plan accounts permit up to 1,000 API calls per minute, while Business accounts support 5,000 calls per minute. If you exceed your limit, the API will temporarily return a 429 Too Many Requests response code.

title: When Aria Escalates Your Ticket
text: While I can resolve most account, billing, and technical questions immediately, complex technical bugs or custom contract requests may require human assistance. If I cannot resolve your issue, I will offer to transfer your conversation to a human specialist. You can also request a human representative at any point during our chat.

title: Contacting PulseFlow Human Support
text: To reach our human support staff directly, type Talk to a human in this chat window or email support@pulseflow.io. I will gather your workspace details and ticket summary so our specialists can jump in without asking you to repeat information. You can track ticket updates directly in your Help Center dashboard.

title: Support Response SLA by Plan
text: Our support team operates Monday through Friday with response times tailored to your plan. Free plan users receive community support, Pro users get email responses within 24 business hours, and Business users enjoy 24/7 chat support. Enterprise accounts receive priority 1-hour response SLAs.

title: Reporting Urgent System Outages
text: If you experience a critical outage affecting live production workflows, select Urgent Escalation when submitting your ticket. Urgent tickets automatically trigger alerts for our 24/7 on-call engineering team. Please reserve urgent tagging for severe service-impacting incidents.
